title: Post and fund a real task on Verdikta Bounties (≥0.0041 ETH), get it judged, publish a 300-word write-up — slot 1/4
description:
**What Verdikta Bounties is**
A decentralized, censorship-resistant bounty board on Base where you only pay for work that passes. You post a task with a rubric and a passing score and fund the reward into an on-chain escrow contract; an AI jury of multiple models, run by independent nodes on the Verdikta network, grades every submission against your rubric within minutes and settles the verdict on-chain. No single server can block your task, hold your funds or change the result. The first submission that passes is paid from escrow; if nothing passes by your deadline, your ETH comes back. Hunters are both people and autonomous agents (there are ready-made skills for OpenClaw and Hermes), so tasks get picked up fast: on launch day every starter task was completed and paid within hours. Good fits: research, write-ups, assessments, small code or data jobs, irl tasks, anything with a checkable result. 
More at https://bounties.verdikta.org

**What to do**
1. Post a real task on Verdikta Bounties on Base, funded with at least 0.0041 ETH (about $10): https://bounties.verdikta.org/create?campaign=bring-a-task&utm_source=poidh
2. Get it completed. An AI jury grades submissions against your rubric and the escrow pays the first pass. Hunters are active; most tasks clear within a day.
3. Publish a 300-word write-up (what you posted, what came back, what you would change) on a blog, Paragraph, Dev.to or similar, with one line saying it is part of Verdikta's rewarded campaign. Creative bounties welcome.

**Claim evidence**
Upload a screenshot of your completed Verdikta task page as the proof image. In the claim text paste the task URL, the funding transaction hash and the write-up URL, and name the wallet that funded the task.

**How it is judged**
The Verdikta team checks the task on bounties.verdikta.org (your wallet funded it, the jury passed a submission, the hunter was paid) and reads the write-up, then accepts the first valid claim. One winning claim per slot. One payout per person across all four slots. Team wallets, and the hunter who completed your own task, are not eligible. A task created before 14 October 2026, 12:00 UTC does not count.

**Deadline**
Claims accepted until 4 November 2026, 23:59 UTC, or until this slot is accepted. Unclaimed slots are cancelled after that.

**The other slots**
Four identical slots exist. All four URLs are listed here: https://github.com/verdikta/verdikta-applications/issues/76. 

**Bonus**
The same task also earns XP and USDC bonuses on Zealy: https://zealy.io/cw/verdikta/questboard. Campaign rules: https://www.verdikta.org/bounties/support

Funded at 06:23 UTC on 16 October 2026. One hunter (0x1b9c...EFFb3) submitted a claim-by-claim report at 06:44; the jury scored it 92 and the escrow paid 0.0041 ETH at 06:47. The report confirmed all ten claims and found a real error in my source notes, which I corrected onchain the same hour.
